summary.name: DeepSeek API
summary.one_liner: Quick-start documentation for the DeepSeek API, which uses an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible format so existing SDKs and tools can call DeepSeek models by changing the base URL.
use_cases: calling DeepSeek models from existing OpenAI-format code
using DeepSeek as a backend for coding assistants
running chat completions with thinking enabled
integrating DeepSeek via the Anthropic SDK
summary.what_it_does: The page explains how to access the DeepSeek API by pointing OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs at DeepSeek base URLs (https://api.deepseek.com and https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic). It lists the model names deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro and notes that the legacy deepseek-v4-flash name now routes to a retired model served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017. It provides curl, Python and Node.js examples of non-streaming chat completion requests, with optional thinking and reasoning_effort parameters and a stream flag. It also points to guides for agent tool integrations and a DeepSeek Harness developer preview.
notable: Drop-in compatibility with OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs by changing base_url and api_key
Thinking mode and reasoning_effort parameters on chat completions
Works as backend for agent and coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and OpenCode
deepseek-flash model name served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
caveats: Legacy model names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are accepted but the underlying models have been retired
DeepSeek Harness is only in developer preview
An API key is required; the page links to a key application step
